# TC.GraphicsLight

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.GraphicsLight"></a>

### TC.GraphicsLight

A light uses the engine's default light texture. Its visible glow stays within radius of target.

Extends: TC.GraphicsCommon

### color (optional)

Default: white.

```text
TC.GraphicsColor
```

### intensity (optional)

0..1. Default: 1.

```text
number
```

### minimum_darkness (optional)

Darkness 0..1 below which the light is not drawn. Default: 0.

```text
number
```

### radius

Visible radius in content pixels, greater than 0.

```text
number
```

### target

Centre.

```text
TC.GraphicsPoint
```
